::: {#exm-ss-between}
#### Between-group sum of squares of two small groups

Let group 1 be $\cb{1, 2, 3}$ and group 2 be $\cb{4, 5, 6}$,
so $\bar y_1 = 2$, $\bar y_2 = 5$, and $\bar y = 3.5$. Then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{SS}_\text{between}
&= 3(2 - 3.5)^2 + 3(5 - 3.5)^2
&& \text{(definition)}\\
&= 3(2.25) + 3(2.25)
&& \text{(square the deviations)}\\
&= 13.5
&& \text{(arithmetic)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
